import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite";
import pg from "pg";

// 방명록 데이터는 SQLite 파일 하나에 둔다. 저장소에 커밋된 data/guestbook.db 에 첫 글 몇 개가 들어 있다.
const DB_PATH = "data/guestbook.db";
// DATABASE_URL 이 있으면 PostgreSQL, 없으면 지금처럼 SQLite
const DATABASE_URL = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
const usePostgres = Boolean(DATABASE_URL);

export type Entry = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  message: string;
  created_at: string;
};

const SQLITE_SCHEMA = `
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
  )
`;

const POSTGRES_SCHEMA = `
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'))
  )
`;

let sqlite: DatabaseSync | null = null;
let pool: pg.Pool | null = null;

function sqliteDb(): DatabaseSync {
  if (!sqlite) {
    sqlite = new DatabaseSync(DB_PATH);
    sqlite.exec(SQLITE_SCHEMA);
  }
  return sqlite;
}

function postgres(): pg.Pool {
  if (!pool) throw new Error("PostgreSQL is not initialised");
  return pool;
}

/** 서버가 요청을 받기 전에 한 번 — PostgreSQL 이면 테이블을 만들고, 비어 있으면 SQLite 파일의 글을 옮겨 온다 */
export async function initDb(): Promise<void> {
  if (!usePostgres) {
    sqliteDb();
    return;
  }
  pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: DATABASE_URL });
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query("BEGIN");
    await client.query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(727001)");
    await client.query(POSTGRES_SCHEMA);
    const existing = await client.query<{ count: string }>("SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM entries");
    if (Number(existing.rows[0]?.count ?? 0) === 0 && existsSync(DB_PATH)) {
      const source = new DatabaseSync(DB_PATH, { readOnly: true });
      try {
        const rows = source
          .prepare("SELECT id, name, message, created_at FROM entries ORDER BY id")
          .all() as Entry[];
        for (const row of rows) {
          await client.query(
            "INSERT INTO entries (id, name, message, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)",
            [row.id, row.name, row.message, row.created_at],
          );
        }
        await client.query(
          "SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('entries', 'id'), COALESCE(MAX(id), 1), MAX(id) IS NOT NULL) FROM entries",
        );
        console.log(`imported ${rows.length} rows from ${DB_PATH} into PostgreSQL`);
      } finally {
        source.close();
      }
    }
    await client.query("COMMIT");
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

/** 화면에 보여 주는 저장소 이름 */
export function storageName(): string {
  return usePostgres ? "PostgreSQL" : "SQLite";
}

export async function listEntries(limit = 50): Promise<Entry[]> {
  if (usePostgres) {
    const result = await postgres().query<Entry>(
      "SELECT id, name, message, created_at FROM entries ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $1",
      [limit],
    );
    return result.rows;
  }
  return sqliteDb()
    .prepare("SELECT id, name, message, created_at FROM entries ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?")
    .all(limit) as Entry[];
}

export async function addEntry(name: string, message: string): Promise<Entry> {
  if (usePostgres) {
    const result = await postgres().query<Entry>(
      "INSERT INTO entries (name, message) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id, name, message, created_at",
      [name, message],
    );
    return result.rows[0]!;
  }
  return sqliteDb()
    .prepare("INSERT INTO entries (name, message) VALUES (?, ?) RETURNING id, name, message, created_at")
    .get(name, message) as Entry;
}

export async function countEntries(): Promise<number> {
  if (usePostgres) {
    const result = await postgres().query<{ count: string }>("SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM entries");
    return Number(result.rows[0]?.count ?? 0);
  }
  const row = sqliteDb().prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM entries").get() as { count: number };
  return Number(row.count);
}

/** 헬스체크용 — DB 에 실제로 질의가 되는지 확인한다 */
export async function ping(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (usePostgres) {
    await postgres().query("SELECT 1");
    return true;
  }
  sqliteDb().prepare("SELECT 1").get();
  return true;
}
